SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT U.*, O.ORGNAME PARENTORGNAME FROM T_CORE_USER U LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG O ON U.PARENTORGID = O.ID) T
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_ROLE_USER R WHERE R.ROLEID = #{role_assigned} AND R.USERID = T.ID)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_ROLE_USER R WHERE R.ROLEID = #{role_unassigned} AND R.USERID = T.ID)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_ROLE_USER A LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ROLE B ON A.ROLEID = B.ID WHERE A.USERID = T.ID AND B.ROLENAME = #{roleName_assigned})
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_ROLE_USER A LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ROLE B ON A.ROLEID = B.ID WHERE A.USERID = T.ID AND A.ROLEID = #{roleName_unassigned})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION A WHERE A.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND A.USERID = T.ID AND A.TARGETID = #{org_assigned})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP WHERE UP.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP.TARGETID = T.PARENTORGID AND UP.USERID = #{loginUser.id})
AND T.USERTYPE IN ('normal', 'sysAdmin')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${targetTable} TAR_ WHERE TAR_.${targetUserIdColumn} = T.ID
AND TAR_.${targetFilterColumn} = #{targetFilterValue}
AND TAR_.${targetFilterColumn1} = #{targetFilterValue1}
)
ORDER BY
T.ORGID, T.ID
SELECT U.*, O.ORGNAME PARENTORGNAME FROM T_CORE_USER U LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG O ON U.PARENTORGID = O.ID WHERE U.ID = #{id}
